title: Commit message convention
description: Conventional Commits 1.0.0 (https://www.conventionalcommits.org). Checked on git commit -m / -F and on gh pr create/edit --title (header rules only).

rules.name: message-required
rules.title: Message must be given non-interactively
rules.description: git commit must carry its message via -m/--message or -F/--file (an editor cannot be used). Commands that reuse a message (--no-edit, -C, --fixup, --squash) are allowed.

rules.name: message-resolvable
rules.title: Message must be statically readable
rules.description: If the message is built from variables or command output (other than a cat heredoc), the hook cannot check it and applies this rule's severity.

good:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat: add login
EOF
)"

rules.name: header-format
rules.title: Header follows type(scope)!: subject
rules.description: The first line must be <type>[(<scope>)][!]: <subject> with exactly one space after the colon.

rules.name: type-enum
rules.title: Type must be one of the allowed types
rules.description: The type must be listed in settings.types (lower case).

rules.name: scope-format
rules.title: Scope format
rules.description: The scope, when present, must match scope_pattern. If allowed_scopes is non-empty, it must also be one of them.

rules.name: subject-min-length
rules.title: Subject is meaningful
rules.description: The subject must have at least min characters.

rules.name: header-max-length
rules.title: Header length limit
rules.description: The whole first line must be at most max characters.

bad: feat: a header that keeps going and going well past the seventy two character limit

rules.name: subject-no-trailing-period
rules.title: Subject does not end with a period
rules.description: The subject must not end with '.'.

rules.name: subject-lower-case-start
rules.title: Subject starts in lower case
rules.description: The first letter of the subject should be lower case (acronyms like API are fine if the second letter is upper case too).

rules.name: subject-imperative
rules.title: Subject uses the imperative mood
rules.description: The subject should not start with a past-tense or third-person verb from the list (write 'add', not 'added' or 'adds').

rules.name: body-leading-blank
rules.title: Blank line between header and body
rules.description: If there is a body, the second line must be empty.

rules.name: body-max-line-length
rules.title: Body line length limit
rules.description: Body and footer lines should be at most max characters. Lines containing a URL are ignored.

bad: one very long unwrapped line of more than one hundred characters ...

rules.name: breaking-change-footer
rules.title: BREAKING CHANGE footer spelling
rules.description: A breaking-change footer must be written exactly 'BREAKING CHANGE: ' or 'BREAKING-CHANGE: ' (upper case).

rules.name: forbidden-patterns
rules.title: No work-in-progress markers
rules.description: The header must not match any of the case-insensitive regex patterns.

rules.name: required-trailers
rules.title: Required trailers
rules.description: Each listed trailer key (e.g. Signed-off-by, Co-Authored-By) must appear as 'Key: value' in the footer. Disabled by default.

rules.name: no-ai-attribution
rules.title: No LLM co-author or AI attribution
rules.description: The message must not credit an AI assistant: no Co-Authored-By (or similar) trailer whose value matches 'coauthor_patterns', and no line matching 'line_patterns' (e.g. 'Generated with Claude Code'). The same patterns are applied to PR bodies by github-cli rule GH009.

good:
feat: add login

Adds the OAuth login form.
bad:
feat: add login

🤖 Generated with Claude Code
